gates.evidence: Starship Galley Chat is a sci-fi comedy cooking chat setting and is fully SFW.
Reward is in-app messages; no cash, clicks, or installs are incentivized.
No loss framing, hostage mechanics, or dark patterns are present.
User taps chip ne1 to open the offer with CTA 'Watch'.
Offer copy states 'Free coins! Watch a video to earn coins.', completely contradicting the actual reward (10-minute session of up to 2 Basic messages) and required action (15-second game).
Decline button 'No thanks' is provided and allows returning without penalty.
Trigger occurs after the reply has finished, avoiding mid-stream interruption.
Eligibility explicitly excludes subscribers ('Non-payers only... never shown to subscribers').
